title: Diagnose Release Pico app connectivity
goal: Read-only diagnose why the Pico application cannot connect during a Release launcher session, without controlling robot hardware or changing network/service configuration.
doneWhen: Relevant Release session, PC Service, and publisher process state and logs are inspected.
The PC Service listening state and the advertised hotspot-network address are checked.
The observed failure is reported with a safe next action or a clearly stated blocker.
decisions: This diagnosis is read-only: do not restart services, change network configuration, or initiate any robot control.

verification.summary: Read-only inspection confirmed the PC Service listening on 63901, the correct host hotspot address as 192.168.50.84, and a prior successful SDK publisher connection; the user confirmed connectivity works.
checks: Read-only process, socket, address, route, and launcher-log inspection completed
Pico connectivity was confirmed by the user after the diagnosis
